Name: Artifact System Drop Framework & Geodes Handler (ASDFGH)
Author: pepoluan
TagLine: A fairer Artifact System + Geode System ... and a FRAMEWORK for Mod Makers!
Description:
This mod, a "redux" of the venerable "Artifact System Fixed", provide fairer odds for artifact/geode drops.

Also, this mod provides drop weighting, so already-found items are less likely to be found again.

Version 0.6.0 implements a FRAMEWORK for mod makers.

[Check the framework's documentation on SourceForge](https://sourceforge.net/p/sdvmod-asdfgh/code/ci/default/tree/ASDFGH/docs/mod-authors.md)
